task.title: Fix missing imports in taiga/projects/userstories/filters.py (latent NameError)
task.description: UserStoryStatusesFilter.filter_queryset uses `logger` and `exc`, but neither is imported, so a non-integer `project` parameter raises NameError instead of BadRequest. The bug is latent on GET /api/v1/userstories, because CanViewUsFilterBackend runs first and already returns 400, but the filter is broken whenever it runs on its own.
acceptance: taiga/projects/userstories/filters.py imports `exc` from taiga.base and defines a module `logger`, like taiga/base/filters.py does
A new test in tests/unit calls UserStoryStatusesFilter().filter_queryset with QUERY_PARAMS {'project': 'abc'} and expects taiga.base.exceptions.BadRequest

harness_gaps.problem: AGENTS.md does not warn that the local rtk output filter truncates `make check-fast` output: I saw only warnings and '248 lines truncated', with no pass/fail summary. The workaround (`rtk proxy make check-fast`) is only written in docs/harness/log.md. It should be in AGENTS.md next to the gate command, or the gate should print a short last line with the result.

The skill gives only integration-test examples (`tests/integration/test_userstories.py`). It does not say that small units such as filter backends can be tested in tests/unit with a mocked request (`mock.Mock(QUERY_PARAMS=...)`) and no database. I found this pattern myself.
